verdict_reason: The published v4.0.1 package archive could not be retrieved within the bounded window, so its actual exports, constructor, methods, response types, and CommonJS/ESM behavior were not verified. A semver-major trading SDK migration must not proceed from names inferred from v3.

root_manifest.decision: Do not remove or consolidate during DEP-1C; ownership requires a separate dependency-parity decision.

non_sdk_rest_provider.classification: independent_direct REST market-data adapter; not a v4 SDK caller and must not be rewritten in DEP-1C

credential_owner.classification: canonical environment alias and paper/live resolver used by the gateway adapter

caller_to_v4_mapping.required_source_edit: Replace the ts-ignore default import with the exact published v4 export and type after inspecting v4 package exports and declaration files.
caller_to_v4_mapping.gate: A TypeScript module-load check must prove the exact ESM and CommonJS behavior under the repository compiler/runtime.

caller_to_v4_mapping.required_source_edit: Bind key, secret, paper/base URL, and client construction to the verified v4 constructor/config type; do not assume v3 option names survive.
caller_to_v4_mapping.gate: Credential-shaped dummy values must construct the client without a provider request, and paper/live endpoint selection must be visible from configuration rather than inferred.

caller_to_v4_mapping.required_source_edit: Translate the request to the verified v4 order request type and normalize the verified v4 order identifier/status fields into the existing BrokerAdapter result.
caller_to_v4_mapping.gate: A fake transport must assert the exact outbound request and typed fixture response; no order endpoint may be called.

caller_to_v4_mapping.required_source_edit: Use the verified v4 cancel method and its identifier/return contract; preserve the adapter's boolean result only after success semantics are proven.
caller_to_v4_mapping.gate: Fake transport must prove request path, identifier placement, success status handling, and error propagation without network access.

caller_to_v4_mapping.required_source_edit: Map the verified v4 account method and typed string/number fields to finite numbers while retaining zero defaults only for absent optional fields.
caller_to_v4_mapping.gate: Typed fixtures must prove cash, buying power, equity, malformed values, and provider error behavior.

caller_to_v4_mapping.required_source_edit: Map the verified v4 positions method and response fields into the existing Position contract with finite-value validation.
caller_to_v4_mapping.gate: Typed fixture arrays must prove empty, fractional, malformed, and provider-error cases.

caller_to_v4_mapping.required_source_edit: Translate nested bracket order, take-profit, and stop-loss fields to the verified v4 order type and verify crypto/equity time-in-force compatibility.
caller_to_v4_mapping.gate: Fake transport must assert the complete nested payload and returned order fixture without submitting an order.

caller_to_v4_mapping.required_source_edit: Use the verified v4 market-data quote client/method and field casing, then return only a finite positive quote.
caller_to_v4_mapping.gate: Fake quote fixtures must cover ask, bid fallback, missing fields, zero, malformed values, and errors without provider access.

stream_usage.note: No Alpaca SDK websocket/stream method was found under the scoped root/backend/gateway/shared production scan. v4 still adds @msgpack/msgpack and ws, so future stream use must be separately qualified.

commonjs_esm.current_behavior: Gateway TypeScript uses a default ESM import suppressed by ts-ignore, consistent with an untyped or CommonJS-interoperated v3 dependency.
required_proof: Inspect v4 package.json exports, main, module, and types fields.
Compile the exact gateway import under the repository TypeScript settings.
Run a Node >=20 module-load check for the built gateway form.
Remove ts-ignore only after the real v4 declaration contract is satisfied.

runtime_and_credentials.ssh_host_gate: The SSH machine's Node runtime and clean install must prove Node >=20 before migration.
runtime_and_credentials.credential_change: unknown until the v4 constructor/config types are inspected
runtime_and_credentials.safety_requirement: Do not log credential values, do not probe accounts, quotes, positions, orders, or cancel endpoints during compatibility verification.

direct_gateway_axios.decision: retain; it is independently imported by the gateway and is not removed by the Alpaca migration

lock_impact.verification_required: Compare npm ls and npm audit before/after in both direct package roots and prove no Axios 0.x remains under Alpaca.

install_scripts.preinstall_install_postinstall: unknown because the package archive was not inspected
install_scripts.required_install_mode: Use --ignore-scripts for lock/install preflight. If a required lifecycle step is later proven, review it explicitly before allowing it on the SSH machine.
install_scripts.classification: NO_GO until package contents and packed manifest are inspected

provider_network_avoidance_test_plan.proof: Inspect packed v4 exports and types in a disposable directory; no module execution.
Compile gateway import, constructor, methods, and response mappings against v4 declarations using dummy credential-shaped strings.
Inject or mock the v4 transport/client so createOrder, cancelOrder, getAccount, getPositions, bracket order, and latest quote use local fixtures only.
Retain missing-credential fail-closed behavior and prove live/account surfaces never fall back to simulated success.
Run npm ls, targeted npm audit, TypeScript compile, existing gateway contract tests, and a no-network process guard.
Defer authenticated read-only SSH account/position/quote checks to an explicitly approved host phase; never submit or cancel orders during compatibility qualification.

required_source_edits_summary: Replace the ts-ignore default import with the verified v4 export and type.
Update constructor/config mapping if v4 option names or endpoint selection changed.
Update every order, cancel, account, positions, bracket, and quote method call to verified v4 APIs.
Update response-field normalization for verified v4 casing and scalar types.
Add a client or transport injection seam if needed to prove all methods without provider access.
Add Node >=20 to deployment/fresh-install gates before enabling the v4 package.
unknowns: Exact v4 export name and default/named export behavior.
Exact constructor name and configuration fields.
Exact trading, account, positions, cancel, bracket, and quote method names.
Exact request types and response field casing/types.
Whether trading and market-data methods live on one client or separate clients.
Packed package lifecycle hooks beyond registry script metadata.
Whether v4 supplies a codemod sufficient for these project-specific response mappings.
acceptance_for_reopening: Published v4.0.1 archive and declaration files are inspected successfully in a disposable directory.
Every matrix row receives an exact verified v4 symbol/type mapping.
SSH and CI Node runtimes are proven >=20.
A source-edit batch is separately approved.
Credential-free compile and fixture tests cover every active method and error seam.
Root and gateway audits prove the Alpaca-owned Axios/ws findings are removed.
No live provider request, order, cancel, runtime start, or credential disclosure occurs.
